bluf: Cosmo5 is the Paris based group that Labelium became: labelium.com resolves to cosmo5.com, the nav reads Part of Cosmo5, and the homepage claims 1,300 experts in 30 offices across 18 countries. The record shows a scaled performance commerce group assembled from absorbed agencies, now leading with a paid AI offer: official OpenAI partner for ChatGPT Ads in Europe, 10 French and Spanish clients launching. Its work index is dated December 2025 and nothing in its sitemap changed in 90 days. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt and no audited product, lists no pricing, and 18 of its 31 clients are names only.
doing:
The positioning line reads: a global marketing group connecting media, commerce, creative, data and technology so forward looking brands grow meaningfully, pitched as future first marketing for an intelligence era. In plain words, a media and commerce buyer selling itself as a data and technology partner. The headline claim is 1,300 experts in 30 offices across 18 countries and a +34% average conversion lift; the record lists office cities from Paris to Singapore; both figures are quoted as claims, no method shown.

The sold mix has no lead line. The core capabilities score 2: Retail Media (Haier Amazon Ads at +213% ad sales, Bialetti on Amazon DSP, feed management), Paid Search (a Chopard SEA budget case through SnapFeat, GHD at +27% PPC ROAS), Data & Measurement (De'Longhi dashboards at +9% margin, Clarins unified data and A/B testing), Creator & Influencer (the trademarked Social Transformation method, a Diageo programme credited with three AMEC awards) and AI Search / GEO, which is paid: its ChatGPT Ads page names it an official OpenAI partner with 10 clients. SEO, Email & CRM, B2B & ABM, Local and Web & Product score 0. The record lists partners OpenAI and Reddit (France's first certified group) and group launched units, StratNXT, SnapFeat and Footsprint among them, roles not shown.

Its AI posture is paid media: it frames a new era of intelligence, but the lead AI offer is ads inside ChatGPT, and the record shows no AI visibility tracking, scorecard or citation product. Every move on record is undated: the rebrand of Labelium to Cosmo5; the OpenAI selection for ChatGPT Ads in Europe; the About timeline of agencies that joined, Feed Manager, M13h, Klickkonzept, 1000heads, Al Dente and Storeis among them, years not shown; and the Reddit certification. News and jobs lists are empty, no ATS is recorded, no pricing model is listed. Conspicuously absent for its size: dated news and a hiring pipeline.
clients:

The book on record is 31 clients, 13 observed and 18 names only, from 24 case study entries, 3 client logos and 4 slugs; the Spanish site titles sit as separate rows (Caso de éxito Haier beside Haier Europe), so the raw count overstates distinct brands.

The observed needs: Haier, commerce and paid performance (N7, N2), the 2025-12-11 case on an Amazon Ads strategy for Haier Europa; Bialetti, commerce and data (N7, N5), the 2025-12-11 Amazon DSP case with AI insights; Colnago, commerce (N7), full funnel media credited with ecommerce revenue; Hisense, paid performance and brand (N2, N3), Prime Video Ads around major sporting events; Leroy Merlin, paid performance (N2), the 2025-12-11 omnichannel case; Diageo, social (N8), the 2025-12-06 Social Transformation roadmap on the ICE programme; Netflix, social (N8), sentiment analysis for a Netflix teen series; Mapal, leads, B2B and web build (N10, N11, N4), lead acquisition, UX and media for B2B expansion.

Clarins, Chopard, Naos and Moschino carry case study titles (cloud reporting, SmartBrand for SEA, media mix, measurement) yet the needs read leaves them named only, with De'Longhi, GHD, KIABI, L'Oréal Canada (Youth To The People), Uniqlo, Santoni, ba&sh, Fnac Darty and Freshly Cosmetics; needs inferred from the sold mix, commerce and paid media first.

As a judgment tied to the edition, this appliance, beauty and luxury base is likely to need retail media measurement and paid placement inside AI answers next (KJ1, the citation replacing the click; KJ2, ads inside AI answers), moderate confidence.

openings: The opening to lead with is the contradiction at the front of its pitch: it sells AI visibility as an official OpenAI ChatGPT Ads partner, yet publishes no llms.txt, blocks no AI crawlers and shows no audited AI visibility product (citation share, scorecard, tracking). A rival that leads with an audited citation number is very likely to win that comparison on evidence, moderate confidence; the falsifier is a Cosmo5 llms.txt or a published AI visibility scorecard in the next compile. Second, Creator & Influencer: it sells a trademarked Social Transformation method with no Instagram, TikTok or YouTube channel linked from its site, so a social first rival with visible channels is likely to contest briefs of the Diageo and Netflix kind. Third, the transition: brand status is merged, the news list is empty and no page changed in 90 days, so it is a roughly even chance that its clients hear the group story from rivals first. The contestable accounts are the shared ones, Netflix (instrument, media-monks, jellyfish, akqa) and Leroy Merlin (fifty-five, k2-internet), plus the 18 names only rows with no described work to defend. Transparent outcome pricing undercuts it, since the record lists no pricing model.
